A four-way cross-shaped lug wrench: two straight bars cross at a round central hub, and each of the four arms ends in a small socket head shaped like a rounded cup with an inner slot.
An upright spark plug: a narrow terminal cap on top, a ribbed insulator body, a wider hexagonal collar, and a threaded lower shank ending in a small hooked electrode.
A round steering wheel: a thick outer rim around a circular central hub, joined by two horizontal spokes left and right and a double vertical spoke running down to the bottom of the rim.
A hatchback in side view facing left: a low sloping bonnet at the front, one long side window under a rounded roof that drops steeply at the rear, and two round wheels.
An estate car in side view facing right: a long flat roof over three side windows, a nearly vertical rear, a short sloping bonnet at the front, and two round wheels.
A sedan outline in side view facing right with no windows: a rounded cabin over a long body, and two rounded U-shaped tyres dipping below the sill instead of full wheels.
A boxy off-road car in side view facing right: a tall square cabin with two windows, a short flat bonnet, and curved fenders arching over two round wheels.
A car seen head-on with no interior marks: a trapezoid windscreen cabin sitting on a wide rounded body, with two straight vertical wheel stubs below.
A quad bike in side view facing right: a long flat body with a dipped saddle in the middle, a handlebar rising just in front of the seat, and two large round wheels.
An early motor car in side view facing right: a tall open cab with a roof at the rear, a long low bonnet ahead with an upright steering post, sweeping fenders, and two round wheels.
A car seen head-on: a trapezoid windscreen cabin over a body whose sides flare outward, two short slot headlights, and two straight vertical wheel stubs beneath.
A car seen head-on with no interior marks: a trapezoid windscreen cabin sitting on a wide rounded body, with two straight vertical wheel stubs below.

A helicopter in side view facing right: a rounded cockpit with a curved window, a long main rotor bar on a short mast, a slim tail boom with a forked fin on the left, and a landing skid below.

A round clock face with four tick marks and hands at a right angle hangs from a horizontal bracket by two short rods. The bracket extends from a tall vertical post topped with a small ring finial on the left.
Four tall vertical wavy lines run side by side. Near their middle, two short parallel horizontal bars cross the inner lines like a blockage band, interrupting the flow.
An open-top sports car in side view facing right: a long, low body, a raked windscreen and a short upright roll-bar stroke above the cockpit, and two round wheels.
A vertical post carrying two direction boards: the upper board points right with an angled tip and the lower board points left, overlapping the post one above the other.
A motor yacht in side view facing right: a long hull with a raised, pointed bow, a cabin with sloping front and rear on the deck, and a small flybridge block on the cabin roof.
A wide rounded-rectangle camera body with a large ringed lens on its left half and a short horizontal indicator dash on the right. A T-shaped mount rises from the top centre.
A tall D-shaped headlamp with its flat edge on the left and round face bulging right. Three short parallel beam lines sit to its left, angled slightly downward toward the lamp.
A double-outlined T-shaped arrow: a horizontal bar with arrowheads at both the left and right ends, and a single stem dropping from its centre to a rounded bottom.
A tall upward arrow on the left and a downward arrow on the right that bends in an S-curve partway down. A small U-shaped median sits between their upper halves.
A D-shaped headlamp with its flat edge on the left and round face bulging right. Three parallel beam lines slant downward to its left, pointing toward the road.
A leftward arrow runs from a small rounded fuel-can shape on the right to an end bar at the far left. The number 10 sits above the arrow's shaft.
A tall rounded-rectangle charging post with a lightning bolt on its face. A cable leaves its lower left side and curls up to a two-prong plug pointing left.
A kick scooter in side view facing right: a long flat deck between two small wheels, a tall steering column leaning back from the front wheel, and a T-shaped handlebar at the top.

An upright thermometer with three short scale ticks on the right of its stem and a round bulb at its base, standing just above a single horizontal wavy line.

A fire engine in side view facing right: a long rear body with a horizontal stripe, a ladder with short rungs along the roof, a taller cab with a slanted windscreen and a roof light, and two round wheels.
A wheel seen side-on: a five-spoke rim with a small round hub sits inside a thick tyre whose base spreads flat against the ground, bulging out at the bottom corners.

A compact folding bicycle facing right: two small round wheels, a single long diagonal main tube rising from the rear axle area to a tall handlebar stem with a hooked grip, and a flat saddle on a slanted post.
The characters 4WD set on one horizontal line in bold, rounded letters with no border or other marks.

A D-shaped headlamp with its flat edge on the left and round face bulging right. Four short parallel beam lines slant downward to its left.
The letters FWD set on one horizontal line in bold, rounded capitals with no border or other marks.

A D-shaped headlamp with its flat edge on the left and round face bulging right. Three parallel horizontal beam lines sit to its left, pointing straight ahead.

A semicircular gauge arc with short tick marks and a needle pointing from a central hub toward the upper right. A letter F sits below each end of the arc.
